clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, the Etched Sigil calls new night elf hunters to their trainer.

Newly awakened night elf hunters receive the Etched Sigil as they enter Shadowglen. Its carved marks of the hunt carry a welcome and summons from Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer who lives high in Aldrassil’s hollowed boughs. The token sends each novice to seek her out and begin instruction in archery, wilderness tracking, and the night elf bond between stalker and beast.
